docs.text: Instruments The Instruments API provides the master list of all tradable securities across supported exchanges — stocks, futures, options, currencies, indices, and commodities. It is the foundation for every other API in the platform. Search securities by name or symbol Retrieve instrument tokens for market data subscriptions Get correct exchange and segment identifiers Validate lot size and tick size before placing orders Map trading symbols across Quotes, OHLC, and WebSocket APIs Build symbol search for your trading application What is an Instrument? An instrument is any financial asset that can be traded in a market. Every security — whether it is a stock, derivative, or currency pair — is represented as an instrument in the RMoney API. Reliance Industries TCS NIFTY 50 Bank Nifty Futures USDINR NIFTY 25000 CE Instrument Structure Every instrument belongs to an exchange and segment. The full hierarchy from exchange down to trading symbol is: Exchange Trading venue — NSE, BSE, MCX NSE Segment Asset class — Equity, F&O, Currency Equity (CM) Instrument The actual security Reliance Industries Ltd Trading Symbol Symbol used in API calls RELIANCE Instrument Types Equity Company shares listed on NSE or BSE cash market. RELIANCE TCS INFY HDFCBANK NSE CM BSE CM Futures Contracts to buy or sell an asset at a specified future date and price. NIFTY JUL FUT BANKNIFTY JUL FUT RELIANCE FUT NSE FO MCX FO Options Contracts giving the right (not obligation) to buy or sell at a strike price. NIFTY 25000 CE NIFTY 25000 PE Call (CE) Put (PE) Currency Foreign exchange instruments traded on the NSE Currency Derivatives segment. USDINR EURINR GBPINR NSE CD Indices Market benchmarks representing a basket of securities. Not directly tradable — used for reference and derivatives. NIFTY 50 BANK NIFTY SENSEX Reference only Instrument Attributes Field Type Description Example ExchangeInstrumentID Integer Unique numeric identifier for the instrument 2885 ExchangeSegment Integer Exchange segment code (1=NSECM, 2=NSEFO…) 1 TradingSymbol String Symbol used in orders and market data RELIANCE Name String Full company or instrument name Reliance Industries Ltd Series String Instrument series — EQ, FUT, CE, PE EQ LotSize Integer Minimum quantity for derivatives 75 TickSize Decimal Minimum price movement allowed 0.05 Understanding Key Fields ExchangeInstrumentID The unique numeric identifier for this instrument on the exchange. This is the token you pass to Quotes, OHLC, and WebSocket APIs. Example 2885 Used in: Quotes API, OHLC API, WebSocket subscriptions ExchangeSegment Integer code identifying which exchange segment the instrument belongs to. Must match when placing orders or fetching data. 1 = NSECM 2 = NSEFO 3 = NSECD 11 = BSECM 51 = MCXFO TradingSymbol The exchange-recognized symbol used when placing buy/sell orders. For derivatives, includes expiry and strike details. Equity RELIANCE Future NIFTY25JULFUT Option NIFTY2572025000CE LotSize Minimum tradeable quantity. For equity the lot size is 1. For derivatives, orders must be in multiples of the lot size or the exchange will reject them. NIFTY FUT 75 units BANKNIFTY FUT 35 units RELIANCE EQ 1 unit TickSize The minimum price increment for a limit order. Prices that are not multiples of tick size are rejected by the exchange. 100.00 100.05 100.10 100.03 — invalid Series The instrument series defines the type of financial contract within an exchange segment. EQ FUTIDX FUTSTK OPTIDX OPTSTK Common Use Cases 1 Search Before Trading Search by company name to find the correct trading symbol and instrument ID before placing an order. Search "Reliance" Get RELIANCE + token 2885 Place order with RELIANCE 2 Subscribe to Market Data Get the instrument token and pass it to the Quotes or WebSocket API to receive live prices. Fetch token = 2885 Subscribe via WebSocket Receive live LTP 3 Build a Symbol Directory Download the full master file daily at market open. Cache it locally so your app can do instant symbol lookups without hitting the API on every search. Download master on startup Parse into local index Search from cache Instruments API Workflow 1 Fetch Instruments Master Download the full list once per day at market start 2 Search Instrument Look up by name or symbol to get token and exchange 3 Get Instrument Token Extract ExchangeInstrumentID and ExchangeSegment 4 Fetch Quotes / Subscribe WebSocket Pass the token to get live market data 5 Place Order Use TradingSymbol + ExchangeSegment in the order payload Best Practices Cache the Master File Locally The master file contains thousands of instruments. Download once at startup and cache in memory — don't re-fetch on every symbol lookup. Refresh Daily The master file changes each day (new contracts, expired options). Re-download at market open (9:00 AM) to stay current. Use Instrument Tokens, Not Names Always use ExchangeInstrumentID for API calls. Symbol names can change; tokens are stable identifiers used by the exchange. Verify Lot Size Before Orders Check the lot size for every derivative before placement. An order quantity that is not a multiple of lot size will be rejected. Common Errors 404 Instrument Not Found The instrument ID or symbol does not exist in the exchange segment. 400 Invalid Exchange The ExchangeSegment code is incorrect or not supported. 400 Invalid Symbol The TradingSymbol does not match any instrument in the segment. 410 Instrument Expired The contract (futures/options) has passed its expiry date. Summary Term Meaning Used For Instrument Any tradable financial asset Foundation for all API calls ExchangeInstrumentID Unique numeric token Quotes, OHLC, WebSocket TradingSymbol Exchange-recognized symbol Order placement ExchangeSegment Exchange + asset class code All API calls Series Contract type (EQ/FUT/CE/PE) Filtering instruments LotSize Minimum trade quantity Derivative order validation TickSize Minimum price movement Limit order price validation

docs.text: Master XTS provides an API call to fetch all tradable instruments as well as additional data in a single structure. This call can be made once per day, and the response can be persisted in local storage or a file based on your application design. You can then fetch instruments or symbols from this dataset throughout the day. The structure of the response is as follows. The pipe (|) and line-separated values can be easily tokenized and bulk-loaded into your storage of choice. Endpoint POST https://xts.rmoneyindia.co.in:3000/apibinarymarketdata/instruments/master Copy Request Body Parameters Parameter Name Type Mandatory Description exchangeSegmentList Array Y Array of exchange segments Request Body JSON { "exchangeSegmentList" : [ "NSECM" , "NSECD" , "NSEFO" ] } Show Full Copy Terminology If InstrumentType is Equities then use below header format: ExchangeSegment|ExchangeInstrumentID|InstrumentType|Name|Description|Series|NameWithSeries|InstrumentID|PriceBand.High|PriceBand.Low|FreezeQty|TickSize|LotSize|Multiplier|DisplayName|ISIN|PriceNumerator|PriceDenominator|DetailedDescription|ExtendedSurvIndicator|CautionIndicator|GSMIndicator Example: NSECM|2885|8|RELIANCE|RELIANCE-EQ|EQ|RELIANCE-EQ|11001000002885|1598|1307.6|6766210.1|1|1|1|RELIANCE|INE002A01018|1|1|RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LTD-EQ|0|1|1 If InstrumentType is Options then use below header format: ExchangeSegment|ExchangeInstrumentID|InstrumentType|Name|Description|Series|NameWithSeries|InstrumentID|PriceBand.High|PriceBand.Low|FreezeQty|TickSize|LotSize|Multiplier|UnderlyingInstrumentId|UnderlyingIndexName|ContractExpiration|StrikePrice|OptionType|DisplayName|PriceNumerator|PriceDenominator|DetailedDescription Example: NSEFO|48225|2|INIFTY|NIFTY2621725700PE|OPTIDX|NIFTY-OPTIDX|26048000048225|588|114.5|180|10.05|65|1|-1|Nifty 50|2026-02-17T14:30:00|25700|4|NIFTY 17FEB2026 PE 25700|1|1|NIFTY2621725700PE If InstrumentType is Futures, spread then use below header format: ExchangeSegment|ExchangeInstrumentID|InstrumentType|Name|Description|Series|NameWithSeries|InstrumentID|PriceBand.High|PriceBand.Low|FreezeQty|TickSize|LotSize|Multiplier|UnderlyingInstrumentId|UnderlyingIndexName|ContractExpiration|DisplayName|PriceNumerator|PriceDenominator|DetailedDescription Example: NSEFO|49229|1|NIFTY|NIFTY|NIFTY26JANFUT|FUTIDX|NIFTY-FUTIDX|26002700049229|28369.8|23211.8|180|10.1|65|1|-1|Nifty 50|2026-01-27T14:30:00|NIFTY 27JAN2026|1|1|NIFTY26JANFUT

docs.text: Quote You can fetch the quote details by using the POST /instruments/quotes request. In the response, you will receive the quote details based on the exchangeSegment and instrumentID, along with the publishFormat provided in the request. The request body must have the content type application/json and should be valid JSON. Endpoint POST https://xts.rmoneyindia.co.in:3000/apibinarymarketdata/instruments/quotes Copy Request Body Parameters Parameter Name Type Mandatory Description instruments Array Y Array of instrument objects exchangeSegment ExchangeSegments ↗ Y ExchangeSegment exchangeInstrumentID ExchangeInstrumentID 👁 Y Exchange Scrip code or Symbol Token is unique identifier xtsMessageCode xtsMessageCode ↗ Y It is system generated message code publishFormat PublishFormat ↗ Y PublishFormat Request Body JSON { "instruments" : [ { "exchangeSegment" : 1 , "exchangeInstrumentID" : 22 } ], "xtsMessageCode" : 1502 , "publishFormat" : "JSON" } Show Full Copy Response Body Parameters Parameter Name Type Description mdp mdp 👁 xtsMessageCode quotesList Object Response of subscribed instrument listQuotes Object Market data for the list of requested instruments MessageCode MessageCode 👁 It is system generated message code MessageVersion MessageVersion 👁 It is system generated message version ApplicationType ApplicationType 👁 It is system generated ApplicationType TokenID TokenID 👁 It is system generated TokenID ExchangeSegment ExchangeSegment ExchangeInstrumentID ExchangeInstrumentID 👁 Exchange Scrip code or Symbol Token is unique identifier ExchangeTimeStamp ExchangeTimeStamp 👁 A timestamp represents the time at which an event occurred, as recorded by the exchange. Bids Object The bid price displayed in most quote services is the highest bid price in the market. The ask or offer price on the other hand is the lowest price a seller of a particular stock is willing to sell a share of that given stock. Asks Object The ask price is the lowest price a seller is willing to accept for a share/unit of a stock. Size Size 👁 Total quantity available at the Ask or Bid price Price Price 👁 Highest price at which buyers are willing to purchase the instrument TotalOrders TotalOrders 👁 Total number of buy orders placed at the bid or ask price. BuyBackMarketMaker BuyBackMarketMaker 👁 Indicates whether the bid is placed by a buy back market maker. Touchline Object Touchline represents the best Bid and best ask prices for a security at any given time during the trading day. BidInfo Object The bid price displayed in most quote services represents the highest price a buyer is willing to pay in the market. AskInfo Object The ask price is the lowest price at which a seller is willing to accept for a share of a given stock. LastTradedPrice LastTradedPrice 👁 The price at which the most recent trade for the instrument was executed. LastTradedQuantity LastTradedQuantity 👁 The quantity traded in the most recent transaction. TotalBuyQuantity TotalBuyQuantity 👁 The total quantity of buy orders currently available in the market. TotalSellQuantity TotalSellQuantity 👁 The total quantity of sell orders currently available in the market. TotalTradedQuantity TotalTradedQuantity 👁 The cumulative quantity of the instrument traded during the trading session. AverageTradedPrice AverageTradedPrice 👁 The volume weighted average price (VWAP) of all trades executed during the trading session. LastTradedTime LastTradedTime 👁 The timestamp at which the most recent trade occurred (exchange time). LastUpdateTime LastUpdateTime 👁 The timestamp of the latest market data update received from the exchange. PercentChange PercentChange 👁 The percentage change in price compared to the previous close. Open Open 👁 The price at which the instrument first traded when the market opened for the session. High High 👁 The highest traded price of the instrument during the trading session. Low Low 👁 The lowest traded price of the instrument during the trading session. Close Close 👁 The most recent traded price or the official closing price of the session. TotalValueTraded TotalValueTraded 👁 The total traded value during the session, calculated as price × quantity for all trades. BuyBackTotalBuy BuyBackTotalBuy 👁 The total buy quantity placed under buy back activity (exchange specific). BuyBackTotalSell BuyBackTotalSell 👁 The total sell quantity placed under buy back activity (exchange specific). docs.text: Instrument By ID You can search for instruments by using the POST /search/instrumentsbyid request. In the response, you will receive the instrument details based on the instrumentID provided in the request. The request body must have the content type application/json and must contain valid JSON. Endpoint POST https://xts.rmoneyindia.co.in:3000/apimarketdata/search/instrumentsbyid Copy Request Body Parameters Parameter Name Type Mandatory Description instruments Array Y Array of instrument objects exchangeSegment ExchangeSegments ↗ Y ExchangeSegment exchangeInstrumentID ExchangeInstrumentID 👁 Y Exchange Scrip code or Symbol Token is unique identifier Response Body Parameters Parameter Name Type Description AGM AGM 👁 Indicates if an Annual General Meeting is scheduled for the company AllOrNone AllOrNone 👁 Indicates if the order must be executed fully or not at all. Bonus Bonus 👁 Bonus shares declared per existing share. Dividend Dividend 👁 Dividend amount declared per share. EGM EGM 👁 Indicates if an Extraordinary General Meeting is scheduled. AuctionDetailInfo Object Additional details about an auction event. AuctionNumber AuctionNumber 👁 Unique identifier for a specific auction. AuctionStatus AuctionStatus 👁 Current status of an auction. InitiatorType InitiatorType 👁 Type of entity initiating the auction or corporate action. SettlementPeriod SettlementPeriod 👁 Number of days for settlement of trades. TotalBuyQty TotalBuyQty 👁 Total buy quantity in the auction or order book. TotalSellQty TotalSellQty 👁 Total sell quantity in the auction or order book. AuctionQty AuctionQty 👁 Quantity allocated in the auction. AuctionPrice AuctionPrice 👁 Price at which auction quantity is settled. BestBuyPrice BestBuyPrice 👁 Highest buy price currently in the stock. BestSellPrice BestSellPrice 👁 Lowest sell price currently in the stock. ELMargin ELMargin 👁 Extreme Loss Margin required for the instrument. Interest Interest 👁 Interest rate applicable to a debt instrument or derivative. ISIN ISIN 👁 International Securities Identification Number, unique per security. MinimumFill MinimumFill 👁 Minimum quantity that can be executed in a single order. Rights Rights 👁 Number of rights shares issued per existing share. IssuedCapital IssuedCapital 👁 Total capital issued by the company. BoardLotQuantity BoardLotQuantity 👁 Minimum number of units that can be traded in one lot. FaceValue FaceValue 👁 Face value of the security per unit/share. Spread Spread 👁 Difference between best buy and sell price. CallAuction1Flag CallAuction1Flag 👁 Indicates if a first call auction is applicable. docs.text: Instrument By Search String You can search for instruments by using the GET /search/instruments request. In the response, you will receive the instrument details based on the searchString provided in the request. Endpoint GET https://xts.rmoneyindia.co.in:3000/apibinarymarketdata//apimarketdata/search/instruments Copy Request Body Parameters Parameter Name Type Mandatory Description searchString String Y Search keyword to find matching instruments (e.g., RELIANCE) Response Body Parameters Parameter Name Type Description ExchangeSegment ExchangeSegment ↗ Exchange segment in which the instrument is listed. ExchangeInstrumentID ExchangeInstrumentID 👁 Exchange script code or Symbol Token is unique identifier. InstrumentType InstrumentType ↗ Type of financial instrument. Name Name 👁 The official symbol or short name of the instrument as defined by the exchange. DisplayName DisplayName 👁 A user-friendly name of the instrument used for display purposes in applications. Description Description 👁 A detailed description of the instrument, including company or contract details. Series Series 👁 The exchange-defined series under which the instrument is listed (e.g., EQ, BL, A). NameWithSeries NameWithSeries 👁 The instrument name appended with its series (e.g., ‘RELIANCE-EQ’). InstrumentID InstrumentID 👁 A unique system-generated identifier assigned to the instrument or trading system. PriceBand Object The permitted price range within which the instrument can trade during a session. High High 👁 The upper limit of the price band for the instrument. Low Low 👁 The lower limit of the price band for the instrument. CreditRating CreditRating 👁 The credit rating assigned to the instrument, if applicable (typically for debt instruments). HighString HighString 👁 The upper price band is represented as a formatted string. LowString LowString 👁 The lower price band is represented as a formatted string. HighExecBandString HighExecBandString 👁 The upper execution price band displayed as a formatted string. LowExecBandString LowExecBandString 👁 The lower execution price band displayed as a formatted string. FreezeQty FreezeQty 👁 The maximum order quantity allowed per order for the instrument. TickSize TickSize 👁 The minimum price movement allowed for the instrument. LotSize LotSize 👁 The minimum tradable quantity for the instrument. UnderlyingInstrumentId UnderlyingInstrumentId 👁 The unique instrument identifier of the underlying asset for a derivative contract. UnderlyingIndexName UnderlyingIndexName 👁 The name of the underlying index on which the derivative contract is based. ContractExpirationString ContractExpirationString 👁 The contract expiration date represented as a formatted string. RemainingExpiryDays RemainingExpiryDays 👁 The number of calendar days remaining until the contract expires. ExchangeSegment ExchangeSegment ↗ Exchange segment in which the instrument is listed. ExchangeInstrumentID ExchangeInstrumentID 👁 Exchange script code or Symbol Token is unique identifier. StrikePrice StrikePrice 👁 The strike price at which the option buyer can buy or sell the underlying asset. OptionType OptionType ↗ Defines whether the option is a Call or Put. docs.text: WebSocket Connection WebSocket Connection is the first step in real-time market data streaming. It creates a live link between your application and the Market Data server, allowing market updates to be delivered instantly. Secure connection Token authentication Live streaming Auto-reconnect Low latency Continuous session How Connection Works Login via REST → Initiate Connection → Authenticate → joined Event → Subscribe & Stream 1. Login via REST Login through the REST API to receive a Market Data token and userID. 2. Initiate Connection Client sends a connection request to the WebSocket server endpoint. 3. Authenticate Server validates the token. If valid, the WebSocket connection is established. 4. joined Event Server fires the joined event confirming the connection is active. 5. Subscribe & Stream Client subscribes to instruments and live data starts streaming automatically. Connection Status Events Event Description joined - Connection established successfully. - Fired when the client connects and is authenticated by the server. success - Connection request processed successfully. - Returned after a valid connect or subscribe action completes. error - Connection could not be established or authentication failed. - Check the token validity and server URL before retrying. logout - Session ended and connection has been closed. - Reconnect and re-authenticate to resume streaming. Example: https://xts.rmoneyindia.co.in:3000 reconnection - Auto-reconnect on disconnect. - Set to True to automatically reconnect if the connection drops. docs.text: WebSocket Events WebSocket Events are real-time notifications sent by the server to inform the client about connection status, orders, trades, positions, and other important market activities. Connection events Order updates Trade notifications Position changes Error alerts Real-time push Connection & System Events Event Description joined - WebSocket connection established successfully. - The client is now connected and ready to receive data. - Usually the first event received after connecting. success - A request or operation completed successfully. - Confirms that the requested action was processed. - Commonly received after a successful subscription request. warning - A non-critical issue or notification. - The connection remains active and operational. - Used to alert the client about potential issues. error - An operation failed or could not be completed. - Usually includes an error message or reason. - May occur due to invalid requests or authentication failures. logout - User session has ended and connection is closed. - No further updates will be received until reconnection. - Re-authenticate to resume streaming. Trading Events Event Description order - An order-related update has occurred. - Sent when an order is placed, modified, cancelled, or status changes. - Helps track order activity in real time. trade - A trade has been executed. - Sent when a buy and sell order are matched. - Provides trade execution details like price, quantity, and time. position - A position-related update has occurred. - Sent when there is a change in open positions or holdings. - Helps users monitor their portfolio in real time. tradeConversion - A trade or position has been converted. - Example: Converting a position from MIS to CNC. - Sent after successful product type conversion. getOrder - Returns details of existing orders. - Used to retrieve order information through the socket connection. - Provides current order status and related data. getOrderRejection - An order has been rejected. - Includes the rejection reason from the system or exchange. - Helps users identify and resolve order issues. Market Data Events Override these methods in your MarketDataSocketClient subclass to receive data. Connection Events class MyFeed ( MarketDataSocketClient ): async def on_connect ( self ): print ( "Connected!" ) async def on_disconnect ( self ): print ( "Disconnected!" ) async def on_error ( self , data ): print ( "Error:" , data ) Price Events Event 1512 — LTP Only Lightweight LTP-only tick. Lowest bandwidth option. on_event_last_traded_price_full Event 1501 — Touchline LTP plus best bid/ask and volume. on_event_touchline_full Event 1502 — Market Depth Full 5-level order book. on_event_market_depth_full Event 1505 — OHLC Candle Live Open, High, Low, Close candle data. on_event_candle_data_full Event 1510 — Open Interest Total active futures/options contracts. on_event_open_interest_full Event 1507 — Market Status Exchange session state updates. on_event_instrument_property_change_full Interactive (Order) Events class MyOrderHandler ( InteractiveSocketClient ): async def on_order ( self , data ): print ( f"Order {data['AppOrderID']} → {data['OrderStatus']}" ) async def on_trade ( self , data ): print ( f"Trade: {data['TradingSymbol']} {data['TradedQuantity']} @ {data['TradedPrice']}" ) async def on_position ( self , data ): print ( f"Position: {data['TradingSymbol']} NetQty: {data['NetQty']}" ) Event Code Reference Code Event Bandwidth 1512 LTP only Very low 1501 Touchline (LTP + bid/ask) Low 1502 Full depth (5 levels) Medium 1505 OHLC candle Medium 1510 Open interest Low 1507 Market status Very low !!! tip Subscribe only to the event codes you actually need. Using 1502 (full depth) for hundreds of instruments simultaneously uses significantly more bandwidth than 1512 (LTP only).

docs.text: WebSocket Overview WebSocket creates a live connection between your application and the RMoney server. Once connected, the server automatically sends real-time market updates whenever prices or market information change — no repeated requests needed. Real-time streaming Persistent connection Low latency Full-duplex Reduced API calls High volume data Two WebSocket Channels Market Data Socket Live prices, bid/ask, depth, OHLC ticks {root}/?token=...&publishFormat=JSON&broadcastMode=Full Interactive Socket Order updates, trade confirmations, position changes {root}/?token=...&userID=...&apiType=INTERACTIVE WebSocket Lifecycle Connect → Authenticate → Subscribe → Stream Data → Disconnect 1. Connect Client establishes a WebSocket connection with the RMoney server. 2. Authenticate Validates the session using the token received from the Login API. 3. Subscribe Register instruments or data streams with an event code to start receiving updates. 4. Stream Data Server continuously pushes market updates whenever data changes. 5. Unsubscribe Stop updates for selected instruments without closing the connection. 6. Disconnect Close the WebSocket connection when streaming is no longer needed. Event Codes (Market Data) Code Data Type Description 1512 LTP Only Last Traded Price only — minimal data, maximum speed. 1501 Touchline LTP, Bid, Ask, Volume, Open Interest — full top-of-book data. 1502 Market Depth Full 5-level bid/ask order book depth. 1505 OHLC Candle Live Open, High, Low, Close candle data for a given interval. 1510 Open Interest Total open futures/options contracts for a derivative instrument. 1507 Market Status Exchange session state — Open, Closed, Pre-open, etc. WebSocket vs REST API REST API Request every time data is needed Higher latency per request More network overhead Not suitable for real-time feeds → WebSocket Data pushed automatically on change Ultra-low latency Minimal network overhead Built for real-time applications When to Use What Use Case Recommended Live price feed for a dashboard WebSocket — Market Data Real-time order status updates WebSocket — Interactive Fetching historical candles REST — OHLC endpoint Placing / modifying / cancelling orders REST — Interactive API One-time instrument lookup REST — Instruments endpoint Common Use Cases Live Market Quotes Stream real-time bid/ask prices for any instrument. Touchline Streaming Receive LTP, open, high, low, close, and volume updates. Market Depth View best 5 buy/sell prices and quantities in real time. Index Updates Track NIFTY, SENSEX, BANKNIFTY live index values. Trade Notifications Get instant alerts when trades are executed in the market. Order & Position Real-time order status and position change tracking. See Connection for setup details and Events for handling data.
